ranked.headline: Computational frameworks link single-cell and spatial profiles to regulatory structure
ranked.summary: Integrating scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, and spatial omics now supports inference of regulatory networks, cell alignment, and spatial gradients from unpaired…

ranked.headline: Graph and optimal-transport couplings align spatial and single-cell representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend foundation models with spatial graphs, optimal transport, and contrastive alignment to bridge modalities that lack one-to-one…

ranked.headline: New computational tools interpret copy number, missense, and pharmacogenomic variants
ranked.summary: Learned models and calibration are being applied to copy number, variant effect, and pharmacogenotype calls from sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Omics models now test subgrouping, decomposition and model-form choices explicitly
ranked.summary: Recent sepsis, vaccine, signature and microbiome papers test modeling decisions against benchmarks rather than fixing them in advance.

ranked.headline: Omitted epistatic terms shift GWAS null test statistics toward anti-conservative inflation
ranked.summary: Interaction-aware association modelling meets molecular phenotype resolution while a preprint quantifies null distortion from omitted epistasis.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked sequencing methods spanning nanopore, TCR repertoire, and primer design
ranked.summary: Method development across nanopore, TCR, and primer-design workflows is now paired with explicit reference testing against established benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Graph and phylogenetic methods refine variant, copy number, and lineage inference
ranked.summary: Pangenome and sequence-graph representations now extend variant, copy number, and metagenomic analyses beyond single linear references.

ranked.headline: Language models applied to protein, mRNA and genome sequence design and prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend pretrained language models to embedding services, sequence design, codon optimization and viral genome analysis.

ranked.headline: Learned representations of structure and sequence for binding and property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work tests electron density, motif pretraining, and inverse-folding embeddings as inputs for affinity, epitope, and structure-search prediction.

ranked.headline: Sequencing inference models increasingly encode explicit genomic reference structure
ranked.summary: Recent late-2025 preprints embed reference-aware structure into models for methylation, haplotyping, lineage inference, imputation, and association analysis.

ranked.headline: Controls and benchmarks test what learned molecular predictors actually capture
ranked.summary: Predictive performance in drug, toxicity, and protein interaction models now requires split design, cold-start tests, and debiasing before it can be trusted.

ranked.headline: Tools refine microbial taxonomy, abundance and variant calls from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Containerized pipelines and bias-aware abundance methods are appearing across amplicon, metagenomic and genome assembly workflows.

ranked.headline: Computational models link cancer incidence, plasticity and aging to cellular dynamics
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and statistical models now tie population-level incidence, tumor plasticity and tissue aging to measurable cellular and transcriptomic states.

ranked.headline: Observable-constrained simulations refine protein conformational ensembles and dynamics
ranked.summary: NMR, crystallographic, SAXS and PMF-derived constraints are now being built into simulations of disordered, folded and condensate-forming proteins.

ranked.headline: Inferring unobserved infection and lineage quantities from routine surveillance data
ranked.summary: Wastewater, serology, and trial data are being modeled to recover latent infection, lineage, and protection quantities.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided generative design of L- and D-peptide and antibody binders
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply structure-guided algorithms to design peptide binders of both chiralities and to co-optimize antibody affinity and stability.

ranked.headline: Higher-order and manifold representations are reshaping models of brain connectivity
ranked.summary: Recent work moves brain modeling from raw fMRI and connectome signals toward complexes, manifolds, and control-theoretic timescale estimates.

ranked.headline: Context-resolved regulatory networks link genomic variation to cancer mechanisms
ranked.summary: Single-cell and population-scale datasets now resolve regulatory and structural variation by cell type, sex, and repair mechanism in cancer genomes.

ranked.headline: New methods infer gene regulation, specificity and transcript usage from omics data
ranked.summary: Recent work adds isoform-aware, entropy-based, and normalization approaches to gene-level inference from transcriptomic and chromatin data.

ranked.headline: Long-read sequencing resolves haplotype, isoform, and structural variation across samples
ranked.summary: Long-read RNA-seq and population-scale SV catalogs now define sample-specific isoforms and structural variants for interpretation.

ranked.headline: Open-source R and Python tools are standardizing spatial and single-cell omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and new preprocessing packages test method-dependent performance across spatial transcriptomics, DIA proteomics, and ASAPseq workflows.

ranked.headline: Interpretable models link motif syntax to cell type-specific regulatory elements
ranked.summary: Interpretable and transformer-based sequence models are being applied to regulatory syntax, enhancer specificity, and RNA-RNA interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Disease onset as cellular state transition in aggregation, glial bioelectrics, and injury
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply explicit state-transition formalisms to protein aggregation, glioblastoma initiation, and neuronal injury under mechanical load in TBI.

ranked.headline: Higher-order topology and network embeddings applied to disease omics data
ranked.summary: Expression data are increasingly recast as topological or network-embedded objects to detect group differences and recover known disease proteins.

ranked.headline: Diffeomorphic mapping and ANTsX pipelines register multimodal brain data to atlases
ranked.summary: Multimodal whole-brain datasets, including MERFISH, fMOST, MRI and LSFM, are being aligned to Allen CCFv3 and DevCCF atlases.

ranked.headline: Multi-step omics and drug discovery analyses packaged as single executable workflows
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous steps, from data processing to inference and evaluation, are now bundled into single executable units with natural-language access.

ranked.headline: Learned models address missing, sparse, and cross-platform heterogeneity in omics data
ranked.summary: Recent items pair masked autoencoders, negative binomial models, and foundation models with sparse, incomplete, or platform-dependent omics measurements.

ranked.headline: Thermodynamic, kinetic and regulatory layers added to metabolic network models
ranked.summary: Metabolic network models are being extended with thermodynamic constraints, kinetic time-course fitting and genome-scale regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes and k-mer methods scale sequence search to million-genome collections
ranked.summary: Memory-bounded index designs now target million-genome k-mer search and gzipped FASTQ parsing on commodity hardware.

ranked.headline: Faster fragment binding prediction balancing accuracy against computational cost
ranked.summary: Fragment-scale binding work must balance throughput against physical fidelity, prompting acceleration of simulation and quantum chemistry methods.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics across taxa links architecture, hybrid coupling and speciation
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies and genome-wide coupling estimates now enable quantitative comparison of genome architecture and speciation across many taxa.

ranked.headline: Sequence-level motif tools map methylation, Z-DNA and CpG-linked features genome-wide
ranked.summary: Nanopore-based methylation motif detection and genome-scale Z-DNA prediction offer new routes to prioritizing non-canonical sequence elements.

ranked.headline: Prediction tools uncover hidden microbial proteins, enzymes and disordered regions
ranked.summary: Structure and language-model predictors now reach genome-scale microbial proteomes, exposing viral-like elements, enzymes and disordered proteins.

ranked.headline: Provable linear-time algorithms for snarl, superbubble, and bubble detection
ranked.summary: Pangenome and phylogenetic networks require provably correct structure detection at scale, and four recent preprints supply linear-time and exact methods.

ranked.headline: MD and enhanced sampling reveal lipid and ion control of transporter gating
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply all-atom and enhanced-sampling MD to resolve transporter energy landscapes in explicit membranes.

ranked.headline: Antibody-antigen structures and databases reveal convergent binding and immune escape
ranked.summary: Large standardized antibody-antigen datasets and structure analyses now enable quantitative comparison of binding and variant escape at scale.

ranked.headline: LLM agents orchestrate tools for enzyme design, gene set curation and cell annotation
ranked.summary: Agents that call retrieval, structure parsing, literature mining, and notebook execution are now being tested on discrete biological analysis tasks.

ranked.headline: Software tools render gene loss and recombination genealogies for direct inspection
ranked.summary: Packaged, interface-accessible tools now detect and render gene loss and ancestral recombination graphs from assemblies and inferred genealogies.

ranked.headline: Computational inference layers extend what proteomic and imaging assays resolve
ranked.summary: Pooled IP-MS, multiplexed tissue imaging, and SILAC vesicle tracing are each paired with dedicated correction or inference algorithms.

ranked.headline: Calibrating and comparing mechanistic models against constrained data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add comparison tests for transmission-tree ensembles, PyMC tooling for likelihood-free inference, and phylodynamic benchmarks.
